note: Which work each catalogue row is, where the row cannot say so itself. `core/work.ts` derives a key from a title that carries a catalogue mark or a member number — about one row in nine — and everything here covers the rest. `aliases` renames a set the derivation found under its name to the mark it is really known by, keeping each row's member number. `sets` names a set the derivation cannot see at all, by a composer pattern and one title pattern per number, with `least` the fewest rows it may resolve to before the definition has rotted. `rulings` is the last word, keyed by song id — a content fingerprint, so a ruling outlives a re-slugging — and overrides both. Resolved by `npm run songs:bake` into public/songs/works.json; nothing here reaches a visitor's bundle.
